tonight.headline: Tuten turns questionable — set the lineup so his fallback is live
body: Bad news first: Tuten was limited on Wednesday with his ankle/foot and ESPN now lists him QUESTIONABLE. As your lineup is set (Diggs in FLEX, Gordon on the bench), if he is inactive at 13:55 Sunday nobody on your bench can take his RB slot — Gordon and Etienne kick off at 12:00. Waddle practised but has not been cleared; Wilson's quarterback was limited.

ESPN projects 136.3 to 128.2 and gives you 54%. Panda Attack have filled their byes (Skattebo in the flex, Schultz at tight end). One Do-first move: Gordon into an RB slot, Tuten to FLEX, Diggs to the bench — the projection lineup (137.2), and it keeps Diggs and Waddle as live fallbacks.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Prescott (22.3), Javonte Williams (19.7) and Pickens (15.8) all play Dallas–Tennessee at 12:00: one Cowboys shootout moves three of their starters at once (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive with no live fallback — about 17 projected points to zero. The Do-first card is the fix.

case.label: The problem
case.body: As set, Tuten sits in an RB slot and every back on your bench plays at 12:00 (Gordon at Buffalo, Etienne at Chicago). Jacksonville–New York kicks off at 15:25; inactives come at 13:55, after both lock.

case.label: The player
case.body: Tuten was limited Wednesday with his ankle/foot (SI Jaguars report; NBC 21:14Z 18 Nov). Last week he missed Wednesday and Thursday and still handled 29 touches — he is probably fine, but the label is real until Friday.

case.label: The fix
case.body: Gordon (13.9) into an RB slot, Tuten (17.0) into FLEX, Diggs (13.0) to the bench. That is the lineup check's projection lineup — Gordon over Diggs is a 0.9 coin flip, taken by rule. With Tuten in FLEX, Diggs (Monday 19:15) or Waddle (Sunday 15:25) can replace him at 13:55.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten plays and Diggs outscores Gordon in Week 11 (archive) — the coin flip lost; or Tuten is inactive and the FLEX still scores zero because the swap was not made in time.
